name: Geneva Drive
desc: A patent-plate Geneva stop where a continuously turning driver pin whips a slotted star wheel round exactly one station, then its locking crescent holds the star dead still through the long dwell — the intermittent index computed from real tangency geometry, an output pointer snapping between graduations, centrelines and callouts flagging ENGAGED versus LOCKED.

energy.doc: drive speed + glow + line weight + plate drift

scale.doc: mechanism size — 2.2 fills the frame with the star wheel

hue.doc: plate tint (film/schematic); other styles are fixed inks

slots.doc: star slot count (3..6) — sets index angle and dwell fraction

anno.doc: centrelines, output dial, callouts, title block

style.doc: aesthetic: toned drafting film / prussian blueprint / aged brass / engraved plate / abstracted stick-and-circle schematic

alpha.doc: ink opacity over the plate ground
